description: AgentOS Tidemark dependency updates. Status: Phase 0 draft (2026-10-16, revised after review). JSON has no comments, so this field records the justification.

Why Renovate and not Dependabot: (1) Renovate refreshes the digest of an unchanged tag (fedora-bootc:45 is rebuilt daily) and can hold each Containerfile on its own tag (45 in Containerfile, 44 in Containerfile.f44); (2) a regex manager keeps the bootc-image-builder, syft and trivy images pinned by digest inside workflow env blocks, which Dependabot does not parse; (3) it updates SHA-pinned GitHub Actions together with their version comments; (4) the concept document already names Renovate for digest pinning.

Cooldown: the 7-day minimumReleaseAge applies to GitHub Actions only. Quay and GHCR return no release timestamps, so with the default minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour (timestamp-required) a cooldown on container images would hold their updates indefinitely. Container-image updates (base images and workflow tool images) instead arrive on a weekly schedule, each pull request runs the image build and both boot tests, and a human reviews every one before merging.
Cost: the hosted Mend Renovate GitHub App needs write access to the repository; the founder must approve installing it, or run Renovate self-hosted instead.
Not covered (update by hand): the actionlint version and SHA-256 and the pip hashes in .github/workflows/lint.yml, and COSIGN_VERSION in build-image.yml.

customManagers.description: Container images pinned as name:tag@sha256:digest in workflow files (bootc-image-builder, syft, trivy).

packageRules.description: Main image stays on Fedora 45; moving to Fedora 46 needs a new base-image ADR.
Fallback image stays on Fedora 44 until launch.
Base-image digest refreshes: one grouped pull request per week; each one runs the image build and both boot tests.
Supply-chain cooldown for GitHub Actions: wait 7 days after a release before proposing it. The GitHub datasources return release timestamps, so the cooldown can release these updates.
Workflow tool images (bootc-image-builder, syft, trivy) on Quay and GHCR: no release timestamps exist, so no cooldown; a weekly schedule and human review instead.
